verdict.rationale: The evidence documents dashboard creation, a Dashboard REST API and a Slack integration listing, but nothing about subscribing to dashboards or alerting on abnormal metric movement. Dashboards and a JSON data API are adjacent features or building blocks, not subscriptions or anomaly alerts, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can subscribe to dashboards and get alerted when a key metric moves abnormally
